discovery_scope: All declared root blog sitemaps, published public blogPost CMS records and the verified historical inventory. Category landing pages are separately retained as excluded article candidates.
gaps: The CMS raw article bodies retain all content fields. Converted text covers Portable Text spans, code, tables, quotes and accordion descriptions; images, videos, embeds, buttons and linked references remain outside the prose extraction.
Short or empty CMS entries need independent canonical page extraction. Current root language paths include a publisher test record; exposed metadata is not editorial endorsement.
Deleted, private and unlinked posts outside declared sitemap and published CMS collections remain unknown.

read_articles.reading_scope: Substantive textual article explanation read through the official web page. Figures are not used as unique evidence.
read_articles.contract_verification_limits: No LangCache API, threshold default, cost benchmark or permission enforcement was executed. Current conventional cache references already cover coherence, origin protection and persistence, so this is a narrower semantic reuse boundary candidate.

recommendation.mechanism: The article tunes semantic thresholds using false match tradeoffs, applies tenant and contextual filters before similarity matching and combines exact matching with semantic reuse. A useful candidate addition is to an AI correctness or caching reference: validate accepted false matches separately from hit rate and enforce the exact reuse scope before approximate lookup. The proposed permission, source version and model version namespace checks are engineering inferences beyond the article, to be verified for the selected service.
recommendation.proposed_check: Proposed, unexecuted: similar account questions come from different tenants, then permission and policy change. Reject wrong identity or stale scope despite a high similarity score, while allowing an approved same scope paraphrase. Report correct accepted answers and latency rather than hit rate alone.
recommendation.disposition: Research candidate only. No skill instructions or behavioral evaluation were changed by this publisher report.

automatic_extraction_limits: Extraction does not verify article identity or complete semantics; main container text can retain ancillary prose. Deliberate reading is recorded independently.
